verdict.rationale: Cake's own docs say founders can create SAFEs and convertible notes in a full contract editor, raise them in one workflow with digital signing, and see SAFEs and notes on the live cap table. However, modeling of conversion terms (valuation caps, discounts, interest, conversion mechanics) is not documented; the evidence only shows general raise and dilution modeling, so full story coverage is not established. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of SAFE/note conversion-term modeling (cap, discount, interest, conversion into a priced round), detail on the send and e-sign flow for investors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create, send, and e-sign SAFEs or convertible notes in-platform, and they land on the cap table with their conversion terms modeled
